question: Which of the following medications is used in the treatment of Chagas disease?

analysis: Chagas disease is caused by the parasite Trypanosoma cruzi. The medication used in the treatment of Chagas disease includes benznidazole and nifurtimox. Among the options provided, benznidazole is the medication used in the treatment of Chagas disease.
